name: Indravati

source.name: Dandakaranya Range, near Mardiguda village, Thuamul Rampur block

sink.name: Confluence with the Godavari
sink.location: Near Bhadrakali, at the Chhattisgarh-Maharashtra-Telangana tri-junction

did_you_know: Known as the 'lifeline' of Chhattisgarh's Bastar district, the Indravati forms the spectacular Chitrakoot Falls, often called the 'Niagara of India'.
For long stretches it forms the boundary between Chhattisgarh and Maharashtra before joining the Godavari at a tri-state junction.
